body:
Leonard,

The backlog is done. 35 companies are in the "Q4 commitments log" sheet in the Q4 commitments folder (shared with you), and everyone waiting on us got a written answer today.

WHAT WE'RE KEEPING (Arthur's keep-running list)
- Vaultline: nightly DB backups, moving to Standard at $19/month on Oct 12
- Certwell: SSL cert for the API domain, $89/year, due Oct 20
- Pingwise: night pager, moving to Team at $29/month from Nov 1
I told all three we're staying.

WAITING ON ARTHUR OR YOU TO SIGN (cards are on the Harmony Games board, To Do list)
- Playfuse: mutual NDA on ESG's template, so no lawyer review needed. Needed by Oct 8, before their call
- Kinetic Arcade: JP/KR publishing LOI. ESG first (12 months' exclusivity). Needed by Oct 20
- Orbit Store: November featuring agreement, accepted in their partner portal. Needed by Oct 24
- Lumencloud: $25k credits program. ESG first (36-month term). Needed by Oct 31
- Bundlehouse: holiday bundle for Domino Delights. ESG first (18-month licence of our name/art). Needed by Nov 1
- Markward: free brand-monitoring tier, click-through terms. No deadline
I sent ESG one intake email per agreement for the three ESG ones.

For reference:
- Ended, all cancelled or declined in writing: Brightlane, Ascendo, Lingora, Panelpulse, Pixel Harbor booth, Soundvault, Wishwave (partner-booked travel, per your Monday change), Streamcast, Reviewly (trial cancelled before it moves to $79/month on Oct 20) and Clipforge. Clipforge hit its pilot cap, so the $1,800/month Studio plan would have started Oct 16. I cancelled in writing to Paylane.
- Parked to the Jan 5 review: Glyphworks, Driftwood Audio, Quillcraft, Loopnote, Hootline, Retainly, Benchmarkly, Tilecast, Echohall, Framewell, Cloudlark, Pressbeam.
- Already answered, nothing new sent: Motive Forge (Arthur), Spotlight Fest (Robert), and Lanternfly and Balancy (you, both "later", so they come back in January).

Contacts for every company are in Contacts, with the company in the job field.

Frederick
